items.title: Every fppf covering is refined by a two-stage Zariski-then-finite-locally-free tower
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an fppf covering {S_i -> S}, the lemma builds a Zariski open covering S = union U_j, surjective finite locally free W_j -> U_j, Zariski open coverings W_j = union W_{j,k}, and surjective finite locally free T_{j,k} -> W_{j,k} such that {T_{j,k} -> S} refines {S_i -> S} — the purely Zariski-local-on-the-base domination (in contrast to the etale-local L16107 and the qcqs-global finite L16118, both collected). The retained proof is written: start from the etale-local covering {V_a -> S'_a -> S} of chapter lemma dominate-fppf-etale-locally (card L16107); then the standard approximation remark (remark-topologies: a finite locally free surjection can be built Zariski-locally on the base dominating a given etale covering) supplies W_{j,k} mapping into individual S'_a; base change T_{j,k} = W_{j,k} x_{S'_a} V_a is finite locally free over W_{j,k} and lands inside S_i by construction — the author's everything is clear unpacks to this single fibre-product identity.
